rows.question: Where do market prices (open/close) come from?
rows.known: No official source publishes NFL market prices; the store and every market-dependent column are schema-ready and blank.
rows.missing: A price provider (and whether its licence permits storage)
rows.how_to_discover: Owner decision; then add the provider to scripts/origin_capture.py and record prices per snapshot phase
rows.status: OPEN — blocks fair-vs-market diff, CLV, ROI, demotion trigger D-1a

rows.question: When is the cycle-close capture run?
rows.known: Week-10 markets are open; the close phase exists in the store and the capture script supports it.
rows.missing: A schedule (pre-kickoff Sunday) and an owner to arm it
rows.how_to_discover: Owner decision; run `python3 scripts/origin_capture.py close` before the first Week-10 kickoff and rebuild

rows.question: Which replacement ordinals are real?
rows.known: 42 of 76 absences have a named replacement on the club chart.
rows.missing: Club confirmation that the chart's deeper names are actual next-ups (charts are labelled unofficial by the clubs)
rows.how_to_discover: Cross-check club transaction wires / official game participation once available; treat the join as a lead only

rows.question: Are the season-to-date correlations stable?
rows.known: Each row publishes n and a 95% CI; n is season-to-date only.
rows.missing: The rest of the season (and prior seasons) to widen n
rows.how_to_discover: Weekly re-capture (the feed grows automatically); multi-season backfill per suggestion S-A04
rows.status: OPEN — CI published with every value

rows.question: Is the parlay leg-dependence estimate usable?
rows.known: phi is published with its n (weeks evaluated); it is a tiny sample.
rows.missing: A sample that can separate dependence from noise
rows.how_to_discover: Recompute as weeks accrue; do not price correlated parlays until phi has a real n

rows.question: What are the leaderboard rewards?
rows.known: The brief says the competition 'provides rewards for top performing strategies'.
rows.missing: Pool, currency, cadence and funding — none of this exists in the repo
rows.how_to_discover: Owner decision; until then the leaderboard publishes signal ranks only and promises nothing

rows.question: Is Week 11's slate originate-able now?
rows.known: The Week-11 schedule is in the feed (scheduled games, official source).
rows.missing: The Week-11 injury report (the league selector still serves Week 10) — originating Week-11 lines without it would silently drop the injury input
rows.how_to_discover: Capture the Week-11 report when the league publishes it, then run the engine and originate in order (side → total → ML)
rows.status: OPEN — Week-11 origination deliberately not fabricated
